semantically_equivalent_models.justification: SD 2.1 (Stable Diffusion 2.1) is the actual name for LDM 2.1 as Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) form the foundation upon which Stable Diffusion was built. Thus, these two are semantically equivalent models.
LDM v2-1-unclip is an iteration of LDM (latent diffusion models) similar to LDM 2.1; they belong to the same family of models.

parent_models.justification: Diffusion models, particularly DDPM (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models), are the broad class of generative models upon which LDMs are built, so DDPM can be considered a parent model of LDM 2.1.

closest_parent_model.justification: LDMs are a type of diffusion model, specifically improved upon DDPMs with latent variables introduced for efficiency and scaling; hence, DDPM is the closest parent model to LDM 2.1.

child_models.justification: This is a specific variant or iteration of the LDM 2.1 model, which provides an additional feature (un-clipping) based on the base model.

closest_child_model.justification: LDM v2-1-unclip is directly derived from LDM 2.1 as a specific variant, making it the closest child model.

sibling_models.justification: Since both CDM and LDM are types or applications of diffusion models, they share the same parent model, DDPM, making them sibling models.

closest_sibling_model.justification: CDM (Convolutional Diffusion Model) is closely related due to the shared architectural origins and application of the diffusion model framework, like the Latent Diffusion Models (LDM 2.1).

unrelated_models.justification: LDP and LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation) are unrelated as they are not based on diffusion models.
LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation) is used for topic modeling, not generative image models.
LDGC does not relate to diffusion models for generating images or related tasks.
LDCQ does not relate to diffusion models for generating images or related tasks.
TrakEM2 is an image processing software not related to generative modeling.
DMR does not explicitly relate to diffusion models for generating images.
NLM (Non-Local Means) is a denoising technique unrelated to generative models.
ABM (Agent-Based Models) are for simulations distinct from diffusion modeling.
ESM-2 (Evo-Structures Models) is unrelated to diffusion generative approaches.
GBM (Gradient Boosting Machine) is unrelated to diffusion model-based image generation.
DLN-2 is not recognized in diffusion model contexts.
RBM (Restricted Boltzmann Machine) is unrelated as it's an energy-based model.
SDMs are not directly relevant to latent diffusion models.
LightGBM is a machine learning model focused on gradient boosting, not diffusion models.
DDBMS is unrelated to diffusion models or image generation.
IDM is not directly related or identifiable within diffusion generative models.
